job_description:
The Mercedes-Benz Group AG is one of the most successful automotive companies in the world. Together with Mercedes-Benz AG, the vehicle manufacturer is one of the largest providers of premium and luxury cars and vans.
Finance & Controlling Insurance is responsible for the financial management of the insurance activities within Mercedes-Benz Insurance Services. As part of your thesis, you will have the opportunity to work on a practice-oriented topic focusing on the optimization of investments and capital efficiency at Mercedes-Benz Reinsurance S.A. under Solvency II requirements.
These are the challenges you will work on:
Analyzing opportunities to optimize investment income and capital allocation while considering Solvency II requirements
Developing a concept to optimize the investment portfolio, with a particular focus on the existing Alternative Investment Fund (AIF)
Analyzing and optimizing the interaction between return, risk, capital requirements and minimum return requirements
Deriving actionable recommendations for a risk- and capital-efficient investment strategy
The final thesis topic will be defined jointly with your university and Mercedes-Benz.
The position can start from December 2026.

Qualifications
Studies in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Business Studies or a comparable field, ideally with a focus on Finance, Investments or Financial Services
Initial practical experience in Financial Services, Asset-Liability Management, Asset Management or Investment Management
Very good German and English language skills, both written and spoken
Proficiency in MS Office
Strong interest in capital markets, investments and regulatory topics
Strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as confidence in working with financial data
A high degree of initiative, independence and a structured way of working

title: Working Student (m/f/d) Strategic Sales & Marketing | German Required
snippet: Studentenjobs, Werkstudent We're looking for a Working Student (m/f/d) Strategic Sales &; Marketing at our headquarters in Munich.
job_description:
You’ll support our sales and marketing team as a true all-rounder: from customer research to pitch materials to campaign content. No working in the background – your slides go into the weekly, your content goes live, your research feeds real decisions.
Build customer &; market understanding: You research customer challenges and the competitive landscape – the foundation for pitches and team decisions, not just a box-ticking exercise.
Pitches that land: You contribute to presentations, business cases, and concepts that get presented in real customer conversations.
Content with your fingerprint on it: You help shape materials for sales and marketing campaigns – from website content to campaign assets.
Projects with your name on them: Depending on current team priorities, you’ll independently own projects end-to-end – whether that’s a revised case study library, a competitive research deck for a new target audience, a content strategy for a campaign topic, or the preparation of an RFP response. The expectation stays the same: you get the responsibility, not just the supporting role.
Ad-hoc support: Whatever is the current priority – varying in complexity, but always with visible impact.
applicant_profile:
Your profile
Why This Role Will Make You Grow Fast
You won’t be learning theory – you’ll be learning craft: how to read customers, how to build arguments that persuade, how to turn research into a clear recommendation. You’ll get one proper onboarding – and then you’re on your own. No consulting background required: if you’re smart, a fast learner, and genuinely want to take on responsibility, you’ll fit right in.
Your Skillset
Academic background: You’re currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, or a comparable field.
Relevant experience: Some practical experience in sales, marketing, or business development is a plus, but not a must – what matters more is your learning curve and drive.
Skills: You have a confident feel for compelling PowerPoint presentations and are comfortable in Excel, for example when putting together business cases.
Mindset: You take ownership without being asked, proactively engage with your team, and approach things with a solutions-oriented mindset.
Language skills: You communicate and present confidently in both German and English – and naturally bring a healthy sense of humor.
what_they_offer:
We offer
Availability: You have 16–20 hours per week available to work on-site at our Munich headquarters during the semester. During semester breaks, flexible up to full-time hours are possible.
Your Winning Deal
Your opportunity: Take on responsibility from day one, contribute to strategic initiatives, and work closely with an ex-consultant as well as smart, experienced experts from sales and marketing – growing together with a team of experts while developing both the company and yourself.
Your benefits: In addition to weekly pizza and snacks on-site, we offer a lunch subsidy (4 x €6.90/month), a subsidized Wellpass membership, discounts via "Corporate Benefits", and fantastic team and company events.
Your workplace: A flexible, hybrid working model in one of our modern, dog-friendly offices.
Your contribution: A position in a profitable company where you have the freedom and trust to help shape things – working with us on the future of work.
Our values: An open, authentic culture and a high-performing, fun team that’s excited to make bold decisions and find new paths together with you.
At yoummday, we value diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications regardless of gender, background, age, sexual orientation, religion, or disability. Different perspectives make us stronger – which is why we actively promote an inclusive work environment where everyone can reach their full potential.

title: Working Student - AI Automation, Procurement (m/f/d)
snippet: Studentenjobs, Werkstudent As a Working Student in AI Automation, you will help turn promising opportunities for automations into working solutions that make a measurable difference.
job_description:
As a Working Student in AI Automation, you will help turn promising opportunities for automations into working solutions that make a measurable difference. Together with our Process & Automation Manager and Procurement team, you will develop practical MVPs that reduce repetitive work and create more time for strategic procurement activities.
You will take ownership of a portfolio of AI automation use cases, from assessing and prioritizing opportunities to rapidly developing and validating MVPs. Beyond individual use cases, you will help build a scalable solution for implementing, expanding and maintaining AI automations across the organization. You will own the solutions you create throughout their lifecycle, from initial concept to reliable day-to-day operation.

What is your Day to Day Mission:
Evaluate and prioritize AI automation use cases based on impact, feasibility and user needs
Translate procurement processes and pain points into practical solution concepts
Build MVPs for AI agents and workflow automations with integrations into the ERP Test solutions with end users and improve them based on feedback
Document process logic, results and realized efficiency gains
Prepare successful MVPs for scaling, integration or handover
Explore new AI capabilities and identify further automation opportunities
What you bring to the team:
You are currently studying business informatics, computer science, data science, engineering, business administration or a comparable subject
You have a strong interest in generative AI, AI agents and process automation
You bring initial practical experience with programming, automation or low-code tools
You enjoy understanding processes and turning ideas into simple, working solutions
You approach problems analytically and are comfortable experimenting with new technologies
You bring a continuous improvement mindset and are confident challenging the status quo
You work independently, communicate openly and actively seek feedback
Experience with APIs, Python, workflow tools or ERP systems such as NetSuite is an advantage
You communicate confidently in English; German is an advantage
Why Quantum-Systems:
We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.
We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.
We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.
We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits:
Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.
Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.
Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.
Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.
Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.
Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.
Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.
About us:
Quantum Systems develops advanced autonomous systems for defense and security operations across multiple domains, powered by integrated software and AI. Quantum Systems is at the forefront of AI-powered aerial, ground, naval robotics, developing a family of smart systems that go far beyond traditional drones. Built on a foundation of in-house hardware, software and AI, our systems transform data into critical insights, empowering decision-making across security, defense and public safety, as well as for the commercial, industrial and GIS sectors. Our vertically integrated system with industry leading endurance, enable seamless interoperability and software interconnectivity. On-board AI powers multi-modality sensing, autonomous navigation, anti-jamming, swarm operations and more.

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.
At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Web Security Fundamentals: OWASP Top 10 as a working tool, not a memorized list. Authentication and session handling, access control, injection classes, SSRF, and what makes multi-tenancy hard.
Comfortable With the Tooling: Burp Suite or equivalent, plus the usual recon and exploitation kit — and the judgment to know when manual beats automated.
Judgment and Discretion: This role comes with access and trust. You stay inside the agreed scope, you don't test things you weren't authorized to test, and you handle what you find responsibly. Non-negotiable.
Language: Fluent English (our working language).
Cloud or Kubernetes security, Infrastructure-as-Code scanning
CI/CD and supply chain security (SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM)
LLM and agent security — prompt injection, tool-use boundaries, agent sandboxing
Detection engineering: not just getting in, but noticing when someone else does
German language skills

job_description:
People. Passion. Possibilities. Three words that make a world of difference.
More than a job. It's a chance to make a real difference.
Welcome to AbbVie! As part of an international company with 57,000 employees worldwide and around 3,500 employees in Germany, you will have the opportunity of addressing some of tomorrows unmet medical needs in close collaboration with your colleagues. Are you passionate about improving global health care? Do you want to contribute to improving patients' quality of life through your expertise? In a challenging work environment that offers opportunities of developing and increasing your own skills? Youve come to the right place!
Together, we break through – as Senior Systems Engineer – Aesthetic Filler & Combination Products (all genders)
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join our Device and Combination Product Development team in R&D. You will contribute to the development of exciting new aesthetic devices and therapeutic combination products for various phases of clinical studies and work closely with cross-functional colleagues in operations as programs transition to commercial development.
In this role you’re also responsible for integration of inputs and risks from multiple disciplines to ensure robust patient-centric product design and performance. In this role, you will be working with a global team of exceptional scientists, engineers, and leaders on a variety of devices, drug delivery systems from syringes to autoinjectors to complex electromechanical pumps, with a focus on Aesthetic Filler devices. Your expertise and leadership will ensure these systems are safe and effective in meeting their intended use for clinical and commercial development programs.
Make your mark
Drive the implementation of holistic Systems Engineering principles within the Design Controls process, with a focus on system architecture and integration, Design Inputs, traceability, risk management, change management, and DHF architecture.
Define and manage user and stakeholder needs, use cases, product requirements, and applicable standards throughout the product development lifecycle.
Lead system and use-related risk management activities, including risk planning and reporting, system risk assessments, and design and process FMEAs.
Oversee and integrate third-party development activities and ensure alignment of Design Control and Quality by Design activities.
Collaborate with cross-functional team members to identify process gaps, recommend and implement improvements, and help standardize methods and ways of working to enhance consistency, efficiency, operational effectiveness, and the development of sustainable business and organizational strategies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and coordinate testing activities, including sample and laboratory resource planning, and drive improvements to processes, methods, and ways of working.
Serve as the dedicated systems engineer for projects, independently owning key deliverables and coordinating stakeholder input as needed to support successful execution.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a closely related discipline with 7+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience.

Expertise in product development from initial concept to release to market is desired with direct experience in combination product or medical device development and familiarity with FDA 21 CFR Part 820.30, 21 CFR Part 4, ISO14971, ISO 13485 and EU MDR preferred.
Strong Expertise in Systems Engineering principles including user and stakeholder need definition; requirements definition; risk management, product architecture, configuration management, traceability, and change management
Expertise in DHF management and creating various Design Control documents in compliance with regulations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve key project challenges, make sound decisions, identify risks, and develop appropriate mitigation plans.
Experience working with third-party vendors, including vendor communication, management, and deliverable acceptance testing; intercultural competence in a global environment.
Experience with Aesthetic Filler products is preferred.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including scientific writing, combined with a self-driven and structured approach to managing priorities and timelines.
Excellent written and oral communication skills in Englisch as well as in German with the willingness to travel internationally as required (10–20%).

job_description:
As Chief Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. As Chief Engineer, you will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. job_description:
Role Description
As a Service Engineer at Doosan Robotics Europe, you will support our European service operations with a primary focus on service ticket management, robot repair, and service-related quotation and invoice management.
The role covers the entire service process, from receiving and managing service requests to coordinating technical support, performing repairs, preparing quotations and invoices, and ensuring that each case is properly followed through to resolution and closure.
We highly value a customer-oriented mindset, positive attitude, passion for the job, professional pride, and effective communication with colleagues, dealers, and customers.
This position requires a high level of ownership, self-reliance, organization, and independent problem-solving, while working closely with the European service team and HQ.
     Key Responsibilities
1. Zendesk & Jira Management - 50%
Manage and follow up on service requests through Zendesk and Jira
Review incoming service tickets and collect the information required for further analysis and resolution
Communicate with dealers and customers regarding issue status, required information, and next steps
Coordinate technical issues internally with service engineers and relevant teams
Create and manage Jira cases for issues requiring additional technical support from HQ
Communicate and coordinate with HQ regarding ongoing technical issues
Track open and pending cases and ensure timely follow-up until resolution and closure
Maintain accurate and well-structured service records and case histories
Identify recurring issues and support internal service reporting and improvement activities
2. Repair Service - 30%
Perform incoming inspection, diagnosis, and repair of collaborative robots and related components
Identify defective components and carry out required parts replacement and repair procedures
Perform functional checks and verification after repair
Conduct basic troubleshooting based on error logs, alarms, and robot system status
Document repair activities, replaced parts, findings, and test results
Maintain accurate repair histories and technical records
Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or HQ when additional technical analysis is required
Support on-site troubleshooting and repair when necessary
3. Quotation & Invoice Management - 20%
Prepare and send service quotations and invoices
Manage commercial documentation related to repairs, spare parts, and other service activities
Communicate with dealers and customers regarding quotations, purchase orders, repair costs, and invoices
Follow up on pending quotations and purchase orders
Maintain accurate records of service-related quotations and billing documentation
Coordinate with internal administration and finance teams when required

job_description:

With our strong brands GMX, WEB.DE and mail.com and over 42 million active users, we are the leading email and communications platform in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. You will work closely with experienced platform and infrastructure engineers and contribute to open-source technologies.

Do you have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable qualification, and have already gained practical experience in platform, infrastructure, or cloud environments? You possess strong Linux skills and are comfortable working with technologies such as Bash, Python, and/or Go, as well as modern Git workflows.
You are passionate about Platform Engineering, automation, observability, testing, and operating highly scalable distributed systems.
You communicate confidently in English, enjoy working collaboratively in a team, and are committed to continuously developing your technical expertise.

title: Master Thesis on Closed-Loop Reasoning in LLM Agents for Evaluating HEMS Parameter Effects Using Time-Series Foundation Models via MCP
job_description: Job Description How can modern Home Energy Management Systems (HEMS) turn complex user requests into concrete and dependable actions? Large Language Models (LLMs) provide powerful capabilities for dialogue and qualitative reasoning, while specialized Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) bring complementary strengths in capturing and predicting complex numerical dynamics. In your thesis, you will explore how these technologies can come together for accurate forecasting and Closed-Loop Reasoning – contribute your ideas to intelligent energy management and apply now! During your assignment, you will connect a specialized Time-Series Foundation Model as an independent service to an existing LLM agent ecosystem using the standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will investigate how numerical time-series predictions generated by the TSFM can be mathematically abstracted at the server level into concise semantic representations, such as load peaks or solar generation surplus, tailored for LLM reasoning. Additionally, you will design an interactive evaluation loop in which the agent explores system parameters, such as charging schedules and setpoints, the model predicts the resulting curve shifts, and the LLM assesses whether the user's objectives are optimally achieved. Finally, you will systematically evaluate scenarios and data representations to determine where specialized TSFMs deliver measurable advantages over pure LLM reasoning in terms of computational efficiency, token consumption, latency, and predictive accuracy. Qualifications Education: master studies in the field of Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or comparable with good grades Experience and Knowledge: strong proficiency in Python, especially familiarity with data and time-series processing libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, as well as modern asynchronous frameworks like asyncio; good understanding of AI and machine learning, with sound theoretical and practical grounding in machine learning, ideally time-series models and foundation models; familiarity with agentic workflows Personality and Working Practice: you are highly self-motivated, using your strong analytical skills to drive independent scientific research Work Routine: we offer you the opportunity to work in a hybrid setup Languages: very good in English Additional Information Start: according to prior agreement Duration: 6 months Requirement for this internship is the enrollment at university. Location: Manching Start: January 2027 Duration: 12 months Definition working student Working students (d/f/m) are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis. This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week. Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. Our mission Mass Properties Manching is responsible for defining, calculating, and controlling the mass data set throughout the entire life‑cycle of an aircraft. This data set includes mass, centre of gravity and moment of inertia at component, system and aircraft levels. It is required, for example, for the preliminary design of future projects, structural design, system development, support of flight‑test campaigns, and in‑service support. Consequently, the department maintains interfaces with a variety of disciplines, both within and outside the Flight Physics domain. To keep the growing mass properties data set organised and to trace every change throughout the development of our new projects, we are building a Python‑driven, SQLite‑backed database application. In parallel, we are exploring how AI‑based automation can further increase the efficiency and accuracy of our analyses.
